body:
Please consider adding the statement and recording the following written disproof.

Target: Written on the Wall II 395b. For connected simple graphs of order > 2, the proposed upper bound is |M| + delta(G[V\A]) + |V\A3|, with the source definitions in the attached manuscript. M is the smallest modal-degree class; A is the ambient minimum-degree class; A3 consists of vertices of ambient degree at least 3. The induced graph is nonempty in the witness.

Jonas J. Gebendorfer, A fifteen-vertex counterexample to Written on the Wall II Conjecture 395b (14 October 2026), supplies a connected graph with 15 vertices and 38 edges, gamma_2 = 6 and proposed bound = 5. Three disjoint cliques, each with two private vertices, certify the lower bound; an explicit six-vertex set certifies equality. The paper also proves an unbounded family, separately from the finite witness.

The archive contains the unchanged manuscript, six other new manuscripts, and a fresh definition-level Python checker. The original supplements mentioned by the PDFs are not included and have not been replayed here. The fresh checker exhausts all 32768 subsets of this graph. Historical WOWII O status is not presented as a current curator decision. This issue is statement intake and mathematical evidence, not a claim of upstream formal verification or exclusive priority. OpenAI Codex assisted with preparation.

Attachment:

[Gebendorfer_New_Manuscripts_2026-10-14.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33452211/Gebendorfer_New_Manuscripts_2026-10-14.zip)
